title: Polytechnic Study Hub 1.0.3 security update
message: Update for safer links and downloads, Android 6 compatibility, verified website links and improved offline recovery.
releaseNotes: Fixed external and special-link handling on Android 6.
Blocked unsafe intent links and restricted downloads to the trusted website.
Forwarded session cookies and file type information for reliable downloads.
Disabled third-party cookies and application-data backup.
Added verified website deep links and improved offline retry.
Improved WebView lifecycle cleanup and dependency metadata.
